speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To help me narrow down the cause, how many weeks pregnant are you, and have you had any recent mosquito bites or consumed unpasteurized dairy products?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. You mentioned eating ice cream three days ago; was that ice cream made from unpasteurized milk? Additionally, have you noticed any stiffness in your neck or a rash?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Iron deficiency anemia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis. The patient's symptoms of fever, headache, and malaise combined with her pregnancy status and history of consuming ice cream (a common vector for *Listeria monocytogenes*) strongly support this diagnosis over iron deficiency anemia, which does not typically present with acute fever and severe systemic symptoms. I am requesting a blood culture and a rapid Listeria IgM/IgG serology test to confirm the infection.
